description: A Site Context turn for "Where do I change the timezone?" that calls ai/find-admin-screens once, then answers with a link to the screen it returned. Entry 0 answers the first round, entry 1 the round that follows the tool response.

content.text: Let me find the screen for that.
You can change the timezone under [Settings → General](/wp-admin/options-general.php), in the Timezone field.
